Ellen (People Ops): Heads-up: orientation set for Fri 10:00 AM PT / 6:00 PM GMT. I just pushed invites to new-hires. Zoom link + short agenda are in the event.
Tomas: Thanks Ellen. Can you confirm whether captions/transcript will be available? I'm in a noisy workspace.
Ellen (People Ops): Yes — we'll enable Zoom closed captions and also auto-upload an Otter.ai transcript to the Notion page.
Nina: I'm JST so that's late for me. Will there be a live APAC-friendly repeat or just the recording?
Ellen (People Ops): We'll run a live APAC session next Monday at 7:30 AM PT / 11:30 PM JST with a 20-minute Q&A. I'll create a separate invite labelled "APAC-friendly" and attach an .ics for Outlook users.
Rohit: Can you add onboarding buddy contact info (Slack handle + email) to the calendar description? Makes follow-up simpler.
Ellen (People Ops): Yep — adding buddy name/email and Slack handles to the description, plus links to pre-reads.
IT-bot: Reminder: finish SSO and MFA before orientation to avoid access delays. Guide: https://intranet.company.com/it/onboarding
Tomas: One small request: could the recording be split into sections (account setup / security / benefits)? Saves rewatch time.
Ellen (People Ops): We'll add timestamps and section jump-links in Notion and paste them into the calendar description after the session.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "New Hire Orientation  Cohort April" Fri 2025-08-15 10:00:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/2468101214. Recording location: https://drive.company.com/orientation-recordings. Invite: new-hires@redwood.com
Nina: Thanks — please post the APAC invite here when it's live so I don't miss it.
Ellen (People Ops): Will do. I'll also post the Notion pre-reads page link here (and attach the Otter.ai transcript after we record). If anyone doesn't get the invites, DM me and I'll send a direct event in your timezone.
Rohit: Appreciated, thanks!
Ellen (People Ops): Reminder email will go out 1 hour before with the checklist and join links. See you (or the recording)!
